independent_review.assembly_comparison_method: Only the .file directive is omitted. Compiler-generated .L* symbols are bijectively renamed by first occurrence; all instructions, referenced constants, external symbols and unwind directives otherwise remain intact. For every pair requiring symbol normalization, both raw assembly files are assembled and every executable ELF section is compared byte-for-byte.

purpose variants avoid custom file includes
complete-version extraction preserves every source byte
manual_review.limits: Assembly and ELF equality refer to the recorded C++23 compiler/configuration matrix and exercised API wrappers. Numerical oracle and standalone-header checks are recorded by the implementation agents.
